_about: THE alert copy of every platform (#42), en + es: an alert notification's title, body and actions, and every mute /
remind-less state line. Android words it from its string resources (monitor AlertCopy, designsystem MuteText;
AlertCopyTest checks every case in en and es), the Mac from AlertText (notifications, AlertCopyTests) and MuteCopy
(lines, MuteCopyTests in en and es). A case with `platform` is that platform's only (the Mac's HIG title case and
ellipsis, Android's direct-reply label); `en_mac` / `es_mac` = the Mac's wording of the same words. `device`: what
'this phone' / 'this Mac' says.
Lines (round f31; the user, 2026-10-22: 'muted alerts should show a countdown, and the Never option makes no sense …
figure out the best copywriting'): wording after AOSP Do Not Disturb (core/res zen_mode_forever 'Until you turn off'
/ 'Hasta que lo desactives', zen_mode_until 'Until %1$s', zen_mode_duration_hours 'For 1 hour' / 'Durante 1 hora').
Durations through Durations.text (lines) and Durations.compact (the card pill). 'side' = the side's alerts: low
(very low too), high (very high, extremely high too), falling_fast, rising_fast, no_data. es side names: de glucosa
baja, de glucosa alta, de bajada rápida, de subida rápida, sin datos. 'side_after' (round f33): a quiet rule after
carbs / rapid insulin ('treatment'), worded like a mute and counting down to the rule's end; 'side_falling': the
falling-back-into-range rule (no end). es 'queda' / 'quedan' agree with the duration (one unit of 1: queda).
Notifications (SPEC §1 'Headline'): 'headline' = the title (kind, treated: the answering treatments acknowledged);
'body' = the value and arrow in the person's unit (mg/dL or mmol/L, the language's decimal separator), the rate for
the fast kinds, the sensor's LO / HI as such, for no data how long ('ageMin' since the last reading, at least the
rule's 20 min) or 'No reading yet' when the source never delivered one, 'No recent reading' when a level alert has
no reading. 'action' = the notification's buttons; 'mute_choice_spoken' = what TalkBack says for a Mute chip.
'all_scope' (#42, UX review: 'Mute all copy should say what it covers'): under Mute all's line on the device.
'headline_escalated' (#39): a follower's title for the wearer's very low nobody answered on the wearer's phone.
'night' (#38): while the night alerts apply, the line every surface that shows alert states says, with the clock
time they end (the platform's clock formatter).
